prompt: Show me all tasks in my OmniFocus inbox
rationale: task_list is the correct query tool for listing/filtering tasks; omit projectId to get inbox tasks

prompt: Get the details for task with ID abc123
rationale: task_get is the single-item fetch by known ID; task_find_by_name is for name search, task_list for filter queries

prompt: Find all tasks named 'Buy groceries'
rationale: task_find_by_name exists specifically for name-based lookup when no ID is known
confusion_pair: task_list (lacks name search), task_get (requires known ID)

prompt: Create 5 tasks for my project all at once: 'Research', 'Outline', 'Draft', 'Review', 'Publish'
rationale: task_batch_create saves 5 JXA round trips; task_batch_create description says 'Prefer this tool over repeated task_create calls whenever you are creating more than one task'

prompt: Mark task xyz789 as completed
rationale: task_complete is the dedicated completion tool; task_update description explicitly says 'Do not use to complete a task; prefer task_complete instead'

prompt: Complete all tasks in my 'End of week' list at once
rationale: task_batch_complete is the efficient batch completion path; task_update in a loop is wasteful

prompt: Move task abc123 to project proj456
rationale: task_move handles project reparenting; task_update cannot change a task's project membership

prompt: Export my 'Work' project as OPML for import into another app
rationale: export_opml exports at project/folder/all scope to OPML format; description says 'Do NOT use to export a single task'

prompt: What tasks are due today?
rationale: task_list with dueBefore filter is the direct query; forecast_get is for structured 'today's plate' view including deferred and flagged
confusion_pair: forecast_get (structured forecast, not a raw filter query)

prompt: Get the OmniFocus forecast view for today
rationale: forecast_get returns the structured forecast perspective grouped by overdue/dueToday/deferredToday/flagged; task_list lacks this grouping

prompt: Read the note on task abc123
rationale: note_get is dedicated to reading plain-text notes; note_get_html for rich formatting; task_get also returns a truncated note field but note_get returns the full note

prompt: The note on task abc123 has important formatting — I need the full rich-text version
rationale: note_get_html preserves HTML formatting (bold, lists, etc.); note_get strips it to plain text

prompt: Append '— follow up needed' to the note on task abc123 without overwriting the existing note
rationale: note_append adds to existing note content; note_set replaces the whole note; description says 'Do not use to replace the note entirely; prefer note_set instead'

prompt: Search OmniFocus for anything related to 'quarterly report'
rationale: search_query runs full-text search across task names AND notes; task_find_by_name only searches task names

prompt: Create a new project called 'Q3 Planning' inside the 'Work' folder
rationale: project_create accepts folderId to place the project inside a folder; folder_create creates a folder, not a project

prompt: Sync my changes to OmniFocus so they appear on my iPhone
rationale: sync_trigger initiates cross-device sync; sync_status is read-only and doesn't trigger anything

prompt: Mark project proj123 as reviewed
rationale: project_mark_reviewed / review_mark_reviewed are the dedicated review actions; project_update cannot set the review date

prompt: I know the names 'Research', 'Draft', 'Review' — find those tasks
rationale: task_find_by_name searches by name; task_get_many requires already-known IDs, task_list doesn't support name filtering
confusion_pair: task_get_many (needs IDs not names), task_list (no name filter)

prompt: I have IDs for 10 tasks — fetch their full details in one call
rationale: task_get_many batches fetch for up to 100 known IDs in one round trip; task_get is single-item only

prompt: Set up a weekly repeating schedule for task abc123
rationale: task_set_repetition is the dedicated repetition setter; task_update description doesn't mention repetition fields because they're handled separately
